properties.text: Receipt type prefix byte must be 0x01 (AccessList), 0x02 (FeeMarket), 0x03 (Blob), or 0x04 (SetCode).
properties.assertion: forall encode_receipt(tx, receipt): prefix_byte in {0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04} iff !isLegacy(tx)

properties.text: encode_receipt and decode_receipt must be inverse operations for all transaction types.
properties.assertion: forall tx, receipt: decode_receipt(encode_receipt(tx, receipt)) == receipt

properties.text: decode_receipt must reject receipts with invalid type prefix bytes not in {1, 2, 3, 4}.
properties.assertion: forall receipt: isBytes(receipt) => receipt[0] in {1,2,3,4} || revert(AssertionError)

properties.text: decode_receipt must strip exactly the first byte before RLP decoding typed receipts.
properties.assertion: forall receipt: isBytes(receipt) => rlp.decode_to(Receipt, receipt[1:]) == decode_receipt(receipt)

properties.text: Non-Bytes receipt objects must pass through decode_receipt unchanged.
properties.assertion: forall receipt: !isBytes(receipt) => decode_receipt(receipt) == receipt

properties.text: Withdrawal must have all four fields (index, validator_index, address, amount) set and be immutable.
properties.assertion: forall w: Withdrawal => w.index:U64 && w.validator_index:U64 && w.address:Address && w.amount:U256 && frozen(w)

properties.text: Header must have all 21 fields set in construction order and be immutable after freeze.
properties.assertion: forall h: Header => len(fields(h)) == 21 && frozen(h)

properties.text: In PoS headers, difficulty must be constant and nonce must be zero bytes.
properties.assertion: forall h: Header (post-merge) => h.difficulty == 0 && h.nonce == Bytes8(0x00)

properties.text: ommers_hash must always be EMPTY_OMMER_HASH in post-merge forks.
properties.assertion: forall h: Header (post-merge) => h.ommers_hash == EMPTY_OMMER_HASH

properties.text: base_fee_per_gas must follow EIP-1559 adjustment rules relative to parent header.
properties.assertion: forall h: Header => h.base_fee == eip1559_adjust(parent(h).base_fee, parent(h).gas_used, parent(h).gas_limit)

properties.text: blob_gas_used and excess_blob_gas must follow EIP-4844 computation rules.
properties.assertion: forall h: Header => h.excess_blob_gas == calc_excess(parent(h).excess_blob_gas, parent(h).blob_gas_used)

properties.text: requests_hash must follow EIP-7685 computation from block execution requests.
properties.assertion: forall h: Header => h.requests_hash == sha256(concat(requests))

properties.text: Block ommers tuple must always be empty in PoS forks.
properties.assertion: forall b: Block (post-merge) => len(b.ommers) == 0

properties.text: Block transactions tuple must only contain supported tx types (Legacy through SetCode).
properties.assertion: forall b: Block, tx in b.transactions: type(tx) in {Legacy,AccessList,FeeMarket,Blob,SetCode}

properties.text: Block must be immutable (frozen) after construction.
properties.assertion: forall b: Block => frozen(b) after construction

properties.text: Log topics tuple must have at most 4 elements (LOG0 through LOG4 opcodes).
properties.assertion: forall log: Log => len(log.topics) <= 4

properties.text: cumulative_gas_used must be monotonically non-decreasing within a block's receipt list.
properties.assertion: forall block, i < j: block.receipts[i].cumulative_gas_used <= block.receipts[j].cumulative_gas_used

properties.text: Receipt bloom filter must be consistent with the receipt's logs.
properties.assertion: forall r: Receipt => r.bloom == logs_bloom(r.logs)

properties.text: Bloom filter bytearray must be exactly 256 bytes.
properties.assertion: forall bloom: Bloom => len(bloom) == 256

properties.text: add_to_bloom bit_to_set must always be in range [0, 2047] via 0x07FF mask.
properties.assertion: forall add_to_bloom(bloom, entry): bit_to_set = Uint.from_be_bytes(hashed[idx:idx+2]) & 0x07FF <= 2047

properties.text: add_to_bloom must set exactly 3 bits per entry (loop indices 0, 2, 4).
properties.assertion: forall add_to_bloom(bloom, entry): popcount(bloom_after XOR bloom_before) <= 3

properties.text: logs_bloom must initialize bloom to all zeros before processing.
properties.assertion: forall logs_bloom(logs): bloom_init == bytearray(256 * [0])

properties.text: logs_bloom must add every log address and every topic exactly once to bloom filter.
properties.assertion: forall logs_bloom(logs): calls_to_add == sum(1 + len(log.topics) for log in logs)

properties.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all received blocks, receipts, and headers must be fully validated.
properties.assertion: forall msg from P2P: validate(msg) before process(msg)

properties.text: Engine API is JWT-authenticated; unauthenticated callers must be rejected.
properties.assertion: forall caller: engineAPI.call(caller) => caller.hasValidJWT == true

properties.text: Data from EL via Engine API must be verified by CL before network propagation.
properties.assertion: forall data from EL via EngineAPI: CL.verify(data) before CL.propagate(data)

properties.text: Any optimization of receipt encode/decode must produce identical results to the reference path.
properties.assertion: forall tx, receipt: optimized_encode(tx, receipt) == encode_receipt(tx, receipt)

properties.text: Any optimized bloom computation must produce identical Bloom output to logs_bloom reference.
properties.assertion: forall logs: optimized_bloom(logs) == logs_bloom(logs)

properties.text: Malformed RLP in P2P receipts must not crash the client or cause unbounded resource use.
properties.assertion: forall receipt from P2P: rlp.decode(receipt) either succeeds or raises bounded error

properties.text: Blocks with tampered header fields (state_root, tx_root, receipt_root) must be rejected.
properties.assertion: forall b: Block from P2P => verify_roots(b.header, b.transactions, b.withdrawals) == true

properties.text: After block validation, header.transactions_root must equal trie root of block transactions.
properties.assertion: forall b: valid_block(b) => b.header.transactions_root == mpt_root(b.transactions)

properties.text: After block validation, header.receipt_root must equal trie root of block receipts.
properties.assertion: forall b: valid_block(b) => b.header.receipt_root == mpt_root(encode_receipts(b))

properties.text: After block validation, header.withdrawals_root must equal trie root of block withdrawals.
properties.assertion: forall b: valid_block(b) => b.header.withdrawals_root == mpt_root(b.withdrawals)

properties.text: LegacyTransaction receipts must not be type-prefixed during encoding.
properties.assertion: forall tx: isLegacy(tx) => encode_receipt(tx, receipt) == receipt (no prefix)
